data.text: Fixed in the working tree, not committed: src/core/search.ts — 'let', 'lets', 's' are stopwords ("Let's" splits at the apostrophe); 'async' folds onto 'asynchronous' (CLIPPED); a rejected name's part before a comma is a name of its own ('Embeddings, in the core' → 'Embeddings'); the share counts only query words some decision uses. src/cli/commands/hook.ts — the reference column is padded to the records printed, not to ones cut for size (second note). Tests: the KNOWN_MISSES entry and both KAD-78 prompts moved into PROPOSALS of test/rejected-before.test.ts; a layout test in test/prompt-hook.test.ts. 1534 passed. One borderline seen outside the test set: 'Add tests for the embeddings note in the docs' now names DEC-26 — a one-word name ('Embeddings') counts as named, as 'MongoDB' always did.
